newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syrian newspaper warns Netanyahu against war.
newsitem.headline: Syrian newspaper warns Netanyahu against war.

text.p: An official Syrian newspaper accused Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Saturday of trying to start war in the Middle East and urged Arab countries to unite their ranks in preparation.
"Such a foolish man (Netanyahu) is crazy enough to take an important decision that could explode and destroy the region," Ameed al-Khouli, director general of al-Thawra newspaper, wrote.
"It is true that he could always start war and aggressions but he cannot decide how and when that war will end and what are the disasters that would be dragged to the region," he said.

It was not the first time that a Syrian newspaper has accused Israel of war-mongering since the rightwing Netanyahu won elections in May and said he was opposed to the "land-for- peace" formula that has underpinned Middle East peace talks.
Israeli Defence Minister Yitzhak Mordechai threatened on Friday in an Israeli newspaper interview of an "extreme" retaliation for any Syrian attack on Israel.

Israeli fears that Syria was preparing for war were fuelled last month when Syria moved thousands of troops inside Lebanon. This followed Israeli threats of retaliation for guerrilla attacks on Israeli troops occupying a strip of southern Lebanon.
The Syrian newspaper urged Arabs to prepare for the possibility of war.

"It is a dangerous period...and we as Arabs should stand with extreme caution before the situation of this man (Netanyahu) and prepare for this possibility (war) seriously and with a national decision that is up to the challenge facing us," al-Thawra said.
